scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic; the finite verifier checks the decision table and examples but is not a substitute for the nonattainability argument. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The model is a three-cell diffuse Poisson process of finite total intensity; the impossibility concerns intensity-continuous CTDTs at observed-history stopping times and does not cover discontinuous explorations. The two-point bound holds almost surely, not on every non-simple input.
title: Two revealed Poisson points already obstruct continuous exploration
